reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Creatine monohydrate is one of the most studied supplements, and 3 to 5 grams a day is the usual range; it doesn't change much whether you're cutting or bulking. Taking it daily matters more than the timing. Because the right dose depends on your body and any health conditions, check with a doctor or dietitian before you start.
